title: Ops follows shared research worker checkpoints and active request elapsed time without replacing account request identity
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed and TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing to a disposable PostgreSQL test server, run run.cmd. The test uses fileDb to create its own isolated database or schema.
S2: Confirm all seven tests run, with zero failures and zero skipped tests.
expect: An active shared research request retains the account request job ID/state, while stage, current source, worker lease, attempt and cleared errors come from its shared worker.
Current snapshot source status replaces stale private status for the same source/ref; other private sources remain.
Running elapsed time advances from the request creation time instead of stopping at its old updated_at.
Completed, cancelled and failed requests keep their own diagnostics and terminal duration; consumed shared results do not override a private follow-up.
Private research remains independent; shared work with no snapshot still exposes its checkpoint.

tests: Ops follows the active shared worker and current snapshot, preserving request identity
Ops keeps completed request diagnostics and frozen duration
Ops keeps cancelled request diagnostics and frozen duration
Ops keeps failed request diagnostics and frozen duration
private research keeps its own diagnostics and live elapsed duration
shared work without a snapshot still exposes worker checkpoints
consumed shared results do not override private follow-up diagnostics
